# NextGen Eco Bags

> Eco-friendly bag manufacturer in Kakinada, Andhra Pradesh, India. Non-woven, jute and custom-printed bags produced in-house and supplied in bulk across India since 2013. B2B and wholesale, quote-based pricing, samples in 5 working days.

Key facts:

- Founded: 2013
- Location: APIIC Colony, Rayudupalem, Ramanayyapeta, Kakinada, Andhra Pradesh 533005, India
- Contact: hello@nextgenecobags.in, +91 91210 53678 (phone and WhatsApp)
- Hours: Monday to Saturday, 9:00-18:30 IST
- Scale: 40M+ bags produced, 500+ brand partners, delivered to 28 states and 4 countries
- Model: direct from factory, quote-based B2B wholesale, MOQ from 1,000 pieces (500 for select boutique runs)
- Materials: 100% recyclable polypropylene non-woven fabric; compostable natural jute (10-14 oz); IS-9833 food-contact compliance
- Printing: in-house flexo, screen and digital, 1-6 colours standard (up to 8), Pantone matching

## Products

- [D-cut non-woven bags](https://nextgenecobags.in/products/d-cut-non-woven): die-cut single-sheet retail bags, 30-120 GSM, up to 6-colour print
- [W-cut non-woven bags](https://nextgenecobags.in/products/w-cut-non-woven): gusseted high-capacity shopping bags with stitched double-layer mouth
- [Loop handle bags](https://nextgenecobags.in/products/loop-handle): premium soft-touch bags with ultrasonic-welded handles for boutiques and gifting
- [Classic jute totes](https://nextgenecobags.in/products/classic-jute-tote): compostable 10-14 oz jute with laminated food-safe interior
- [Branded promotional bags](https://nextgenecobags.in/products/branded-promotional): custom-printed event and corporate bags, direct-to-venue despatch
- [Heavy-duty shoppers](https://nextgenecobags.in/products/heavy-duty-shopper): 15 kg rated, welded double-base, engineered for 200+ reuses
- [Drawstring pouches](https://nextgenecobags.in/products/drawstring-pouch): custom-size pouches for e-commerce, fashion and beauty packaging
- [Custom bespoke bags](https://nextgenecobags.in/products/custom-bespoke): fully engineered to spec - size, GSM, fabric, finish, print

## Industries served

- [Retail](https://nextgenecobags.in/industries/retail): kirana to modern trade checkout bags
- [Pharma](https://nextgenecobags.in/industries/pharma): compliant counter bags for pharmacies
- [Fashion](https://nextgenecobags.in/industries/fashion): boutique and apparel carry bags
- [Events](https://nextgenecobags.in/industries/events): weddings, conferences and festival editions
- [FMCG](https://nextgenecobags.in/industries/fmcg): high-volume promotional and pack-in bags
- [E-commerce](https://nextgenecobags.in/industries/ecommerce): D2C edition runs and fulfilment-friendly packaging
